scope: Twelve actual battles compare fractional damage, fractional forfeitures, each numeric remainder and whole-card losses; eight production activation effect sequences cover per-unit responses, empty/short Reserve, initial/mid-effect prohibition, source departure and changed top card; five production Force-generation limit queries compare fractional maxima. All reference observations agree with native tested outcomes.
method: Battle harness reads production floating-point BattleState directly; framework GetUnpaidLSBattleDamage truncates to integer and is intentionally not used. Float comparisons tolerate only 0.00001 numeric representation error; card losses and action sequences are exact.

Reference activation count constructor accepts integers. Native fractional mandatory amounts are adjudicated from AR rounding, then unit sequences match the production integer effect. This is not a GEMP fractional-argument execution claim.

Generation uses the production limit query with a controlled frozen raw generation value and increments its generation-only counter. Native tests exercise actual core activation commands and preserve the raw value across refresh.
The last-card reorder uses reserveCount to normalize different fixture deck sizes while preserving first/last/second original-card selection.
limitations: Controlled PowerModifier, ResetForfeitModifier, activation-prohibition grants and response interventions do not certify their granting cards. Insert cards and their reveal/replacement timing remain required.
Native-only cases cover fractional attrition, continuous-source restriction lifetime, R2 optional/late prohibition, legacy Stew continuation migration, corrupted snapshots and concession.

Activation prevention/replacement beyond prohibitions, compound-card counts, raw generation modifier providers, ability to inspect/choose arbitrary activation totals, source-specific insert interruptions and complete card/ship/vehicle/setup coverage remain unfinished.
Full native admission remains closed; existing GEMP and Rules Lab paths preserved.
